message: Important Notice Version 1.0.6 Beta 2 introduces an experimental data storage framework. Please proceed with caution when updating, as there is a risk of losing Easy Login specific data.
Feedback wanted Please provide any feedback you might have via email, Discord, or the GitHub page.
Beta 5 is out If you are currently on 1.0.6 Beta 4, please try out the built-in updater on the settings page.

I've been made aware of an import issue that occurs due to shipping the `SematicVersioning.dll` file with Easy Login.
A fix for this will ship either on the 6th or 7th.

I apologize that it's going to take this long, even tho it's such a simple fix, but I won't be home until then.
